# Overview

This workflow fits two independent MOFA models.

1. **Integrated proteomics model:** Olink Reveal and LC-MS/MS are integrated in patients measured by both platforms. Factors are tested against continuous clinical parameters and between compensated and decompensated RV states. Factor 1 is interpreted by Gene Ontology gene set enrichment analysis of the complete ranked weights.

2. **Matched three-view model:** pseudobulk snRNA-seq, Olink and LC-MS/MS are integrated in patients measured in all three modalities. The analysis distinguishes modality-specific from shared molecular variation. Factors are tested against RV state, continuous clinical parameters and histological fibrosis. Factor 2 is interpreted separately in the transcriptomic and proteomic layers by Gene Ontology gene set enrichment analysis.

Proteomic matrices and retained male DCM samples are imported from the preceding proteomics quality-control workflow. BCA concentration is removed from the Olink view before model fitting. MOFA training is unsupervised; RV state and clinical variables are used only in downstream association models. Age and sample storage time are included as covariates.

RV states are defined as:

- **Not overloaded:** mPAP <= 20 mmHg;
- **Compensated:** mPAP > 20 mmHg and TAPSE/sPAP > 0.32;
- **Decompensated:** mPAP > 20 mmHg and TAPSE/sPAP <= 0.32.

Patients with missing mPAP receive `NA` for `RV_group`. Patients with mPAP > 20 mmHg and missing TAPSE/sPAP also receive `NA`.

```{r mofa factor helper functions}
mofa_view_colors <- c(
  "RNA" = "#33A02C",
  "OLINK" = "#E38C82",
  "MS" = "#2166AC"
)


standardise_mofa_view_name <- function(view) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    view == "RNA_pseudobulk" ~ "RNA",
    view == "Olink" ~ "OLINK",
    view == "LCMS" ~ "MS",
    TRUE ~ as.character(view)
  )
}


clean_mofa_feature_name <- function(
    feature
) {
  stringr::str_remove(
    as.character(feature),
    "_(RNA_pseudobulk|RNA|Olink|OLINK|LCMS|MS)$"
  )
}


format_p_value <- function(
    p_value,
    prefix = "P"
) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~
      paste0(prefix, " = NA"),
    p_value < 0.001 ~
      paste0(prefix, " < 0.001"),
    TRUE ~
      sprintf(
        "%s = %.3f",
        prefix,
        p_value
      )
  )
}


prepare_top_factor_loadings <- function(
    weight_table,
    factor_name = "Factor1",
    n_each_direction = 20
) {
  factor_weights <- weight_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Factor == factor_name,
      is.finite(Weight)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Modality =
        standardise_mofa_view_name(
          View
        ),
      Feature_clean =
        clean_mofa_feature_name(
          Feature
        ),
      Feature_label = paste(
        Modality,
        Feature_clean,
        sep = "_"
      )
    )

  positive_weights <- factor_weights %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Weight > 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(
      order_by = Weight,
      n = n_each_direction,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )

  negative_weights <- factor_weights %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Weight < 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_min(
      order_by = Weight,
      n = n_each_direction,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )

  dplyr::bind_rows(
    negative_weights,
    positive_weights
  ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      Weight
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Feature_label = factor(
        Feature_label,
        levels = unique(
          Feature_label
        )
      )
    )
}


plot_top_factor_loadings <- function(
    loading_data,
    title_text
) {
  ggplot(
    loading_data,
    aes(
      x = Weight,
      y = Feature_label
    )
  ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linewidth = 0.35,
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x = 0,
        xend = Weight,
        yend = Feature_label
      ),
      linewidth = 0.65,
      color = "grey65"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        fill = Modality
      ),
      shape = 21,
      size = 3,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = mofa_view_colors,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "MOFA feature weight",
      y = NULL,
      fill = "Modality"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}


scale_mofa_weights_within_view <- function(
    weight_table,
    factor_table
) {
  weight_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Factor %in%
        factor_table$Factor,
      is.finite(Weight)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Feature_original =
        as.character(Feature),
      Feature =
        clean_mofa_feature_name(
          Feature
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      factor_table,
      by = "Factor"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      Factor,
      View
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Oriented_weight =
        Weight * orientation,
      maximum_absolute_weight =
        max(
          abs(Oriented_weight),
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
      Scaled_weight =
        dplyr::if_else(
          maximum_absolute_weight > 0,
          Oriented_weight /
            maximum_absolute_weight,
          0
        ),
      Absolute_scaled_weight =
        abs(Scaled_weight)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}


prepare_mofa_ranked_gene_list <- function(
    weight_table,
    factor_name,
    orientation
) {
  ranked_symbols <-
    scale_mofa_weights_within_view(
      weight_table =
        weight_table,
      factor_table =
        tibble::tibble(
          Factor = factor_name,
          orientation = orientation,
          interpretation =
            factor_name
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      Factor,
      Feature
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Ranked_weight =
        mean(
          Scaled_weight,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(
        Ranked_weight
      ),
      Ranked_weight != 0
    )

  symbol_to_entrez <- bitr(
    ranked_symbols$Feature,
    fromType = "SYMBOL",
    toType = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
  ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      SYMBOL,
      ENTREZID
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ENTREZID =
        as.character(
          ENTREZID
        )
    )

  ranked_entrez <-
    ranked_symbols %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      symbol_to_entrez,
      by = c(
        "Feature" =
          "SYMBOL"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      ENTREZID
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(
      order_by =
        abs(Ranked_weight),
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(
        Ranked_weight
      )
    )

  gene_list <-
    ranked_entrez$Ranked_weight

  names(gene_list) <-
    ranked_entrez$ENTREZID

  sort(
    gene_list,
    decreasing = TRUE
  )
}


prefix_go_descriptions <- function(
    enrichment_result
) {
  if (
    is.null(enrichment_result) ||
    nrow(
      enrichment_result@result
    ) == 0L ||
    !"ONTOLOGY" %in%
      colnames(
        enrichment_result@result
      )
  ) {
    return(enrichment_result)
  }

  already_prefixed <-
    stringr::str_detect(
      enrichment_result@result$
        Description,
      "^\\[(BP|CC|MF)\\] "
    )

  enrichment_result@result$
    Description[
      !already_prefixed
    ] <- paste0(
      "[",
      enrichment_result@result$
        ONTOLOGY[
          !already_prefixed
        ],
      "] ",
      enrichment_result@result$
        Description[
          !already_prefixed
        ]
    )

  enrichment_result
}


run_mofa_gsea <- function(
    weight_table,
    factor_table
) {
  gsea_objects <- list()
  ranked_lists <- list()

  for (
    factor_index in
    seq_len(
      nrow(factor_table)
    )
  ) {
    factor_name <-
      factor_table$Factor[
        factor_index
      ]

    orientation <-
      factor_table$orientation[
        factor_index
      ]

    gene_list <-
      prepare_mofa_ranked_gene_list(
        weight_table =
          weight_table,
        factor_name =
          factor_name,
        orientation =
          orientation
      )

    ranked_lists[[
      factor_name
    ]] <- gene_list

    if (
      length(gene_list) <
        gsea_min_ranked_genes
    ) {
      next
    }

    go_result <- tryCatch(
      gseGO(
        geneList = gene_list,
        ont = "ALL",
        OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
        keyType = "ENTREZID",
        exponent = 1,
        minGSSize = 5,
        maxGSSize = 500,
        eps = 1e-10,
        pvalueCutoff = 1,
        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
        verbose = FALSE,
        seed = TRUE,
        by = "fgsea"
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        warning(
          "GO GSEA failed for ",
          factor_name,
          ": ",
          conditionMessage(e)
        )
        NULL
      }
    )

    go_result <-
      prefix_go_descriptions(
        go_result
      )

    gsea_objects[[
      paste(
        factor_name,
        "GO_ALL",
        sep = "__"
      )
    ]] <- go_result
  }

  list(
    results =
      extract_gsea_results(
        gsea_objects
      ),
    objects =
      gsea_objects,
    ranked_lists =
      ranked_lists
  )
}


extract_gsea_results <- function(
    object_list
) {
  output <- tibble::tibble()

  for (
    object_name in
    names(object_list)
  ) {
    current_object <-
      object_list[[
        object_name
      ]]

    if (
      is.null(current_object) ||
      nrow(
        as.data.frame(
          current_object
        )
      ) == 0L
    ) {
      next
    }

    name_parts <-
      strsplit(
        object_name,
        "__",
        fixed = TRUE
      )[[1]]

    current_table <-
      as.data.frame(
        current_object
      ) %>%
      tibble::as_tibble() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Factor =
          name_parts[1],
        Direction =
          dplyr::if_else(
            NES >= 0,
            "Positive",
            "Negative"
          ),
        database =
          name_parts[2]
      )

    output <-
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        output,
        current_table
      )
  }

  output
}


subset_enrichment_object <- function(
    enrichment_result,
    selected_ids
) {
  reduced_result <-
    enrichment_result

  reduced_result@result <-
    enrichment_result@result[
      enrichment_result@result$ID %in%
        selected_ids,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

  if (
    "geneSets" %in%
      methods::slotNames(
        reduced_result
      )
  ) {
    reduced_result@geneSets <-
      enrichment_result@geneSets[
        intersect(
          selected_ids,
          names(
            enrichment_result@geneSets
          )
        )
      ]
  }

  reduced_result
}


simplify_go_all_result <- function(
    enrichment_result,
    cutoff =
      enrichment_simplify_cutoff
) {
  if (
    is.null(enrichment_result) ||
    nrow(
      enrichment_result@result
    ) < 2L
  ) {
    return(enrichment_result)
  }

  result_table <-
    as.data.frame(
      enrichment_result
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(p.adjust)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      p.adjust
    )

  selected_table <-
    result_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      p.adjust <
        enrichment_simplify_padj_cutoff
    )

  if (nrow(selected_table) < 2L) {
    selected_table <-
      result_table %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(
        n = min(
          enrichment_simplify_max_terms,
          nrow(result_table)
        )
      )
  }

  if (
    nrow(selected_table) >
      enrichment_simplify_max_terms
  ) {
    selected_table <-
      selected_table %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(
        n =
          enrichment_simplify_max_terms
      )
  }

  selected_object <-
    subset_enrichment_object(
      enrichment_result =
        enrichment_result,
      selected_ids =
        selected_table$ID
    )

  selected_result_table <-
    selected_object@result

  if (
    !"ONTOLOGY" %in%
      colnames(
        selected_result_table
      )
  ) {
    return(
      tryCatch(
        clusterProfiler::simplify(
          selected_object,
          cutoff = cutoff,
          by = "p.adjust",
          select_fun = min,
          measure = "Wang"
        ),
        error = function(e) {
          warning(
            "GO simplification failed: ",
            conditionMessage(e)
          )
          selected_object
        }
      )
    )
  }

  ontology_parts <- list()

  for (
    current_ontology in
    c(
      "BP",
      "CC",
      "MF"
    )
  ) {
    current_ids <-
      selected_result_table$ID[
        selected_result_table$
          ONTOLOGY ==
          current_ontology
      ]

    if (length(current_ids) == 0L) {
      next
    }

    current_object <-
      subset_enrichment_object(
        enrichment_result =
          selected_object,
        selected_ids =
          current_ids
      )

    if (
      "ontology" %in%
        methods::slotNames(
          current_object
        )
    ) {
      current_object@ontology <-
        current_ontology
    }

    if (
      "setType" %in%
        methods::slotNames(
          current_object
        )
    ) {
      current_object@setType <-
        current_ontology
    }

    ontology_parts[[
      current_ontology
    ]] <- tryCatch(
      clusterProfiler::simplify(
        current_object,
        cutoff = cutoff,
        by = "p.adjust",
        select_fun = min,
        measure = "Wang"
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        warning(
          "GO simplification failed for ",
          current_ontology,
          ": ",
          conditionMessage(e)
        )
        current_object
      }
    )
  }

  if (length(ontology_parts) == 0L) {
    return(selected_object)
  }

  combined_object <-
    selected_object

  combined_object@result <-
    do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(
        ontology_parts,
        function(x) {
          x@result
        }
      )
    )

  if (
    "geneSets" %in%
      methods::slotNames(
        combined_object
      )
  ) {
    combined_object@geneSets <-
      unlist(
        lapply(
          ontology_parts,
          function(x) {
            x@geneSets
          }
        ),
        recursive = FALSE
      )
  }

  if (
    "ontology" %in%
      methods::slotNames(
        combined_object
      )
  ) {
    combined_object@ontology <-
      "ALL"
  }

  if (
    "setType" %in%
      methods::slotNames(
        combined_object
      )
  ) {
    combined_object@setType <-
      "ALL"
  }

  combined_object
}


simplify_enrichment_objects <- function(
    object_list
) {
  lapply(
    names(object_list),
    function(object_name) {
      current_object <-
        object_list[[
          object_name
        ]]

      if (
        stringr::str_ends(
          object_name,
          "GO_ALL"
        )
      ) {
        simplify_go_all_result(
          current_object,
          cutoff =
            enrichment_simplify_cutoff
        )
      } else {
        current_object
      }
    }
  ) %>%
    stats::setNames(
      names(object_list)
    )
}


fit_factor_fibrosis_models <- function(
    factor_scores,
    factor_names
) {
  required_columns <- c(
    "Factor",
    "Factor_value",
    "Fibrosis_percent",
    "Age_years",
    "Sample_age_days"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    colnames(factor_scores)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Missing fibrosis-analysis columns: ",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  results <- tibble::tibble()

  for (
    factor_name in
    factor_names
  ) {
    factor_data <-
      factor_scores %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Factor == factor_name
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Factor_value,
        Fibrosis_percent,
        Age_years,
        Sample_age_days
      ) %>%
      tidyr::drop_na()

    if (
      nrow(factor_data) < 6L ||
      stats::sd(
        factor_data$Fibrosis_percent
      ) == 0
    ) {
      next
    }

    factor_data <- factor_data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        fibrosis_scaled =
          as.numeric(
            scale(
              Fibrosis_percent
            )
          ),
        age_scaled =
          as.numeric(
            scale(Age_years)
          ),
        storage_scaled =
          as.numeric(
            scale(
              Sample_age_days
            )
          )
      )

    fibrosis_fit <- lm(
      Factor_value ~
        fibrosis_scaled +
        age_scaled +
        storage_scaled,
      data = factor_data
    )

    fibrosis_coefficient <-
      broom::tidy(
        fibrosis_fit,
        conf.int = TRUE
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        term ==
          "fibrosis_scaled"
      )

    results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      results,
      tibble::tibble(
        Factor = factor_name,
        n = nrow(factor_data),
        beta =
          fibrosis_coefficient$
            estimate,
        standard_error =
          fibrosis_coefficient$
            std.error,
        confidence_interval_low =
          fibrosis_coefficient$
            conf.low,
        confidence_interval_high =
          fibrosis_coefficient$
            conf.high,
        t_statistic =
          fibrosis_coefficient$
            statistic,
        p_value =
          fibrosis_coefficient$
            p.value,
        model_R2 =
          summary(
            fibrosis_fit
          )$r.squared,
        adjusted_model_R2 =
          summary(
            fibrosis_fit
          )$adj.r.squared
      )
    )
  }

  results %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      FDR = p.adjust(
        p_value,
        method = "BH"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(FDR)
}


plot_factor_fibrosis_associations <- function(
    fibrosis_results,
    factor_names,
    title_text
) {
  plot_data <- fibrosis_results %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Factor = factor(
        Factor,
        levels = rev(
          factor_names
        )
      ),
      label =
        format_fdr_label(FDR)
    )

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = beta,
      y = Factor
    )
  ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = 2,
      color = "grey50"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x =
          confidence_interval_low,
        xend =
          confidence_interval_high,
        yend = Factor
      ),
      linewidth = 0.7,
      color = "grey35"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        fill = beta
      ),
      shape = 21,
      size = 4,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        x = Inf,
        label = label
      ),
      hjust = 1.05,
      size = 3.1
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#2166AC",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#B2182B",
      midpoint = 0
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(
          0.08,
          0.35
        )
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x =
        "Adjusted coefficient per 1 SD increase\nin histological fibrosis",
      y = NULL,
      fill = "Coefficient"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      )
    )
}
```

# Clinical metadata and RV states

```{r clinical metadata}
clin_all <- readxl::read_excel(clinical_file) %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::matches("^Unnamed")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Collection_date = as.Date(Collection_date),
    Used_date = as.Date(Used_date),
    Sample_age_days = as.numeric(Sample_age_days),
    Age_years = as.numeric(Age_years),
    LVEF_percent = as.numeric(LVEF_percent),
    LVID_mm = as.numeric(LVID_mm),
    LVEDD_mm = as.numeric(LVEDD_mm),
    RVOT_mm = as.numeric(RVOT_mm),
    TAPSE_mm = as.numeric(TAPSE_mm),
    RVIT_mm = as.numeric(RVIT_mm),
    RAA_cm2 = as.numeric(RAA_cm2),
    RVS_cm.s = as.numeric(RVS_cm.s),
    RVSP_mmHg = as.numeric(RVSP_mmHg),
    sPAP_mmHg = as.numeric(sPAP_mmHg),
    mPAP_mmHg = as.numeric(mPAP_mmHg),
    PCW_mmHg = as.numeric(PCW_mmHg),
    PVR_WU = as.numeric(PVR_WU),
    TPG_mmHg = as.numeric(TPG_mmHg),
    CO_l.min = as.numeric(CO_l.min),
    TAPSE_sPAP = TAPSE_mm / sPAP_mmHg
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Group == "DCM",
    Sample %in% retained_dcm_samples,
    toupper(
      trimws(
        as.character(Sex)
      )
    ) != "F"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    RV_group = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(mPAP_mmHg) ~ NA_character_,
      mPAP_mmHg <= mPAP_overload_cutoff ~
        "Not overloaded",
      mPAP_mmHg > mPAP_overload_cutoff &
        is.na(TAPSE_sPAP) ~
        NA_character_,
      mPAP_mmHg > mPAP_overload_cutoff &
        TAPSE_sPAP > coupling_cutoff ~
        "Compensated",
      mPAP_mmHg > mPAP_overload_cutoff &
        TAPSE_sPAP <= coupling_cutoff ~
        "Decompensated",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    RV_group = factor(
      RV_group,
      levels = c(
        "Not overloaded",
        "Compensated",
        "Decompensated"
      )
    ),
    Sex = factor(Sex),
    Etiology = factor(Etiology)
  )

clin_all %>%
  dplyr::count(RV_group, .drop = FALSE)
```

# Preprocess Olink proteomics

The sample-filtered Olink matrix is imported from the proteomics quality-control workflow. All usable Olink proteins are retained. BCA concentration is regressed from the Olink abundance matrix before either MOFA model is fitted.

```{r read olink data}
olink_expr <-
  filtered_proteomics$olink

olink_sample_meta <-
  filtered_proteomics$olink_metadata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    BCA_mg_ml = as.numeric(BCA_mg_ml),
    Batch = factor(Batch)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Sample,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

olink_samples <- clin_all$Sample[
  clin_all$Sample %in%
    colnames(olink_expr)
]

olink_expr <- olink_expr[
  ,
  olink_samples,
  drop = FALSE
]

olink_meta <- clin_all %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    olink_sample_meta %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Sample,
        Batch,
        BCA_mg_ml
      ),
    by = "Sample"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Sample %in% colnames(olink_expr),
    !is.na(BCA_mg_ml)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice(
    match(
      colnames(olink_expr),
      Sample
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Sample,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

olink_expr <- olink_expr[
  ,
  olink_meta$Sample,
  drop = FALSE
]

olink_observed <- matrixStats::rowSums2(
  is.finite(olink_expr)
)

olink_variance_original <- matrixStats::rowVars(
  olink_expr,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

keep_olink_features <-
  olink_observed >= 2 &
  is.finite(olink_variance_original) &
  olink_variance_original > 0

olink_expr <- olink_expr[
  keep_olink_features,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

dim(olink_expr)
```

```{r regress bca from olink}
bca_covariate <- matrix(
  as.numeric(
    scale(olink_meta$BCA_mg_ml)
  ),
  ncol = 1,
  dimnames = list(
    olink_meta$Sample,
    "BCA_scaled"
  )
)

olink_mofa <- limma::removeBatchEffect(
  olink_expr,
  covariates = bca_covariate
)

olink_variance_corrected <- matrixStats::rowVars(
  olink_mofa,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

keep_corrected_olink_features <-
  is.finite(olink_variance_corrected) &
  olink_variance_corrected > 0

olink_mofa <- olink_mofa[
  keep_corrected_olink_features,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

olink_feature_table <- tibble::tibble(
  feature = rownames(olink_expr),
  variance_before_BCA_correction =
    matrixStats::rowVars(
      olink_expr,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
  variance_after_BCA_correction =
    olink_variance_corrected,
  selected_for_MOFA =
    rownames(olink_expr) %in%
      rownames(olink_mofa)
)

bca_correlations_before <- apply(
  olink_expr,
  1,
  stats::cor,
  y = olink_meta$BCA_mg_ml,
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

bca_correlations_after <- apply(
  olink_mofa,
  1,
  stats::cor,
  y = olink_meta$BCA_mg_ml,
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

olink_bca_correction_diagnostic <-
  tibble::tibble(
    feature = names(
      bca_correlations_before
    ),
    correlation_before =
      as.numeric(
        bca_correlations_before
      ),
    correlation_after =
      as.numeric(
        bca_correlations_after[
          names(
            bca_correlations_before
          )
        ]
      )
  )

write.csv(
  olink_feature_table,
  file.path(
    preprocessing_output_dir,
    "Olink_feature_selection_all_proteins.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  olink_bca_correction_diagnostic,
  file.path(
    preprocessing_output_dir,
    "Olink_BCA_correction_diagnostic.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

dim(olink_mofa)
```

```{r Olink BCA correction diagnostic, fig.height=4, fig.width=4}
olink_bca_correction_plot_data <-
  olink_bca_correction_diagnostic %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      correlation_before,
      correlation_after
    ),
    names_to = "stage",
    values_to = "correlation"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(

  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

        "correlation_before",

ggplot(

  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(

      "After correction" = "#63C5C9"
    )

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Absolute protein-wise correlation\nwith BCA concentration"
  ) +
```

# Preprocess LC-MS/MS proteomics

The sample-filtered and log2-transformed LC-MS/MS matrix is imported from the proteomics quality-control workflow. Proteins observed in at least half of the retained samples are used for MOFA.


# Model 1: integrated Olink and LC-MS/MS proteomics

Only patients measured by both proteomic platforms are used. This avoids using platform availability to define factors and makes every proteomics factor directly estimable from both assays.

## Tune the number of proteomics factors

Three seeds are fitted for every candidate number of factors. Each complete execution refits all tuning models and overwrites the corresponding tuning files.

```{r tune proteomics factor number, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
proteomics_tuning_results <-
  tibble::tibble()

for (n_factors in candidate_factors) {
  for (tuning_seed in tuning_seeds) {
    tuning_model_file <- file.path(
      proteomics_output_dir,
      paste0(
        "MOFA_proteomics_tuning_K",
        sprintf("%02d", n_factors),
        "_seed",
        tuning_seed,
        ".hdf5"
      )
    )

    if (file.exists(tuning_model_file)) {
      unlink(tuning_model_file)
    }

    message(
      "Starting proteomics model: K = ",
      n_factors,
      ", seed = ",
      tuning_seed
    )

    tuning_object <- MOFA2::create_mofa(
      proteomics_data
    )

    tuning_data_options <-
      MOFA2::get_default_data_options(
        tuning_object
      )

    tuning_data_options$scale_views <- TRUE

    tuning_model_options <-
      MOFA2::get_default_model_options(
        tuning_object
      )

    tuning_model_options$num_factors <-
      n_factors

    tuning_model_options$likelihoods[] <-
      "gaussian"

    tuning_training_options <-
      MOFA2::get_default_training_options(
        tuning_object
      )

    tuning_training_options$maxiter <-
      tuning_maxiter

    tuning_training_options$convergence_mode <-
      mofa_convergence_mode

    tuning_training_options$freqELBO <-
      mofa_freq_elbo

    tuning_training_options$drop_factor_threshold <-
      -1

    tuning_training_options$seed <-
      tuning_seed

    tuning_training_options$verbose <-
      FALSE

    tuning_object <- MOFA2::prepare_mofa(
      object = tuning_object,
      data_options = tuning_data_options,
      model_options = tuning_model_options,
      training_options =
        tuning_training_options
    )

    MOFA2::run_mofa(
      tuning_object,
      outfile = tuning_model_file,
      use_basilisk = TRUE
    )

    rm(tuning_object)
    gc()

    tuning_model <- MOFA2::load_model(
      tuning_model_file,
      sort_factors = TRUE,
      remove_inactive_factors = FALSE
    )

    tuning_r2 <-
      MOFA2::get_variance_explained(
        tuning_model
      )$r2_per_factor[[1]]

    weakest_factor <-
      tail(
        rownames(tuning_r2),
        1
      )

    weakest_factor_r2 <-
      tuning_r2[
        weakest_factor,
        ,
        drop = TRUE
      ]

    new_tuning_result <- tibble::tibble(
      n_factors = n_factors,
      seed = tuning_seed,
      final_ELBO =
        MOFA2::get_elbo(tuning_model),
      weakest_factor = weakest_factor,
      weakest_factor_total_R2 =
        sum(
          weakest_factor_r2,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
      weakest_factor_Olink_R2 =
        unname(
          weakest_factor_r2["Olink"]
        ),
      weakest_factor_LCMS_R2 =
        unname(
          weakest_factor_r2["LCMS"]
        ),
      n_factors_total_R2_at_least_cutoff =
        sum(
          rowSums(
            tuning_r2,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ) >= last_factor_r2_cutoff
        ),
      model_file = tuning_model_file
    )

    proteomics_tuning_results <-
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        proteomics_tuning_results,
        new_tuning_result
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        n_factors,
        seed
      )

    write.csv(
      proteomics_tuning_results,
      proteomics_tuning_summary_file,
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    message(
      "Finished proteomics model: K = ",
      n_factors,
      ", seed = ",
      tuning_seed
    )

    rm(tuning_model)
    gc()
  }
}

proteomics_tuning_results
```

## Select the proteomics factor number

```{r select proteomics best tuning run per K}
proteomics_best_tuning_runs <-
  proteomics_tuning_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(n_factors) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(
    order_by = final_ELBO,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(n_factors)

write.csv(
  proteomics_best_tuning_runs,
  proteomics_best_tuning_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

proteomics_low_weakest_factor <-
  proteomics_best_tuning_runs$
    weakest_factor_total_R2 <
  last_factor_r2_cutoff

proteomics_low_runs <- vapply(
  seq_along(
    proteomics_low_weakest_factor
  ),
  function(i) {
    end_i <-
      i +
      n_consecutive_low_models -
      1

    end_i <=
      length(
        proteomics_low_weakest_factor
      ) &&
      all(
        proteomics_low_weakest_factor[
          i:end_i
        ]
      )
  },
  logical(1)
)

proteomics_first_low_run <-
  which(proteomics_low_runs)[1]

if (
  length(proteomics_first_low_run) == 1 &&
  !is.na(proteomics_first_low_run)
) {
  proteomics_selected_n_factors <- max(
    proteomics_best_tuning_runs$
      n_factors[
        proteomics_first_low_run
      ] - 1,
    min(candidate_factors)
  )

  proteomics_factor_plateau_reached <-
    TRUE
} else {
  proteomics_selected_n_factors <-
    max(candidate_factors)

  proteomics_factor_plateau_reached <-
    FALSE

  warning(
    paste0(
      "No sequence of ",
      n_consecutive_low_models,
      " consecutive proteomics models with weakest-factor variance below ",
      last_factor_r2_cutoff,
      "% was observed. The maximum tested factor number was selected."
    )
  )
}

proteomics_selected_seed <-
  proteomics_best_tuning_runs %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n_factors ==
      proteomics_selected_n_factors
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(seed)

proteomics_selected_model_settings <-
  tibble::tibble(
    selected_n_factors =
      proteomics_selected_n_factors,
    selected_seed =
      proteomics_selected_seed,
    factor_plateau_reached =
      proteomics_factor_plateau_reached,
    weakest_factor_R2_cutoff =
      last_factor_r2_cutoff,
    consecutive_low_models_required =
      n_consecutive_low_models,
    tuning_maxiter = tuning_maxiter,
    final_maxiter = final_maxiter,
    convergence_mode =
      mofa_convergence_mode
  )

write.csv(
  proteomics_selected_model_settings,
  proteomics_selected_settings_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

proteomics_selected_model_settings
```

## Train the final proteomics model

```{r train final proteomics mofa model, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
proteomics_data <- readRDS(
  proteomics_input_file
)

if (file.exists(proteomics_final_model_file)) {
  unlink(proteomics_final_model_file)
}

proteomics_object <-
  MOFA2::create_mofa(
    proteomics_data
  )

proteomics_data_options <-
  MOFA2::get_default_data_options(
    proteomics_object
  )

proteomics_data_options$scale_views <-
  TRUE

proteomics_model_options <-
  MOFA2::get_default_model_options(
    proteomics_object
  )

proteomics_model_options$num_factors <-
  proteomics_selected_n_factors

proteomics_model_options$likelihoods[] <-
  "gaussian"

proteomics_training_options <-
  MOFA2::get_default_training_options(
    proteomics_object
  )

proteomics_training_options$maxiter <-
  final_maxiter

proteomics_training_options$convergence_mode <-
  mofa_convergence_mode

proteomics_training_options$freqELBO <-
  mofa_freq_elbo

proteomics_training_options$drop_factor_threshold <-
  -1

proteomics_training_options$seed <-
  proteomics_selected_seed

proteomics_training_options$verbose <-
  FALSE

proteomics_object <- MOFA2::prepare_mofa(
  object = proteomics_object,
  data_options =
    proteomics_data_options,
  model_options =
    proteomics_model_options,
  training_options =
    proteomics_training_options
)

MOFA2::run_mofa(
  proteomics_object,
  outfile =
    proteomics_final_model_file,
  use_basilisk = TRUE
)

rm(proteomics_object)
gc()
```

# Proteomics factors in compensated and decompensated RV states

```{r proteomics group association models}
proteomics_factor_names <-
  MOFA2::factors_names(
    proteomics_model
  )

proteomics_group_global_results <-
  tibble::tibble()

proteomics_group_pairwise_results <-
  tibble::tibble()

for (
  factor_name in
  proteomics_factor_names
) {
  factor_data <-
    proteomics_factor_scores %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Factor == factor_name,
      RV_group %in%
        rv_group_comparison_levels
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Sample,
      Factor_value,
      RV_group,
      Age_years,
      Sample_age_days
    ) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      RV_group = factor(
        as.character(RV_group),
        levels =
          rv_group_comparison_levels
      )
    ) %>%
    droplevels()

  if (
    nlevels(factor_data$RV_group) < 2L
  ) {
    next
  }

  group_counts <-
    table(
      factor_data$RV_group
    )

  group_fit <- lm(
    Factor_value ~
      RV_group +
      scale(Age_years) +
      scale(Sample_age_days),
    data = factor_data
  )

  group_test <- drop1(
    group_fit,
    test = "F"
  )

  proteomics_group_global_results <-
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      proteomics_group_global_results,
      tibble::tibble(
        Factor = factor_name,
        comparison =
          "Compensated versus Decompensated",
        n = nrow(factor_data),
        n_compensated =
          unname(
            group_counts["Compensated"]
          ),
        n_decompensated =
          unname(
            group_counts["Decompensated"]
          ),
        F_statistic =
          group_test[
            "RV_group",
            "F value"
          ],
        p_value =
          group_test[
            "RV_group",
            "Pr(>F)"
          ],
        model_R2 =
          summary(group_fit)$r.squared,
        adjusted_model_R2 =
          summary(group_fit)$adj.r.squared
      )
    )

  factor_emmeans <- emmeans::emmeans(
    group_fit,
    ~ RV_group
  )

  factor_contrasts <-
    emmeans::contrast(
      factor_emmeans,
      method = list(
        "Decompensated - Compensated" =
          c(-1, 1)
      ),
      adjust = "none"
    ) %>%
    summary(
      infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
    ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Factor = factor_name,
      n = nrow(factor_data),
      n_compensated =
        unname(
          group_counts["Compensated"]
        ),
      n_decompensated =
        unname(
          group_counts["Decompensated"]
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Factor,
      contrast,
      estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL,
      upper.CL,
      t.ratio,
      p.value,
      n,
      n_compensated,
      n_decompensated
    )

  proteomics_group_pairwise_results <-
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      proteomics_group_pairwise_results,
      factor_contrasts
    )
}

proteomics_group_global_results <-
  proteomics_group_global_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(FDR)

proteomics_group_pairwise_results <-
  proteomics_group_pairwise_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(
      p.value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(FDR)

write.csv(
  proteomics_group_global_results,
  file.path(
    proteomics_output_dir,
    "MOFA_proteomics_factors_compensated_vs_decompensated_global.csv"
  ),

)

write.csv(

    proteomics_output_dir,
    "MOFA_proteomics_factors_compensated_vs_decompensated.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

)
```

# Proteomics factor associations with continuous clinical parameters

Each parameter is tested in a separate model:

`factor score ~ scaled clinical parameter + scaled age + scaled sample storage time`

```{r proteomics continuous clinical association models}
proteomics_continuous_results <-
  tibble::tibble()

for (
  factor_name in
  proteomics_factor_names
) {
  for (
    clinical_parameter in
    clinical_parameters
  ) {
    factor_data <-
      proteomics_factor_scores %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Factor == factor_name
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Sample,
        Factor_value,
        Age_years,
        Sample_age_days,
        dplyr::all_of(
          clinical_parameter
        )
      ) %>%
      tidyr::drop_na()

    factor_data <- factor_data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        clinical_scaled =
          as.numeric(
            scale(
              .data[[clinical_parameter]]
            )
          ),
        age_scaled =
          as.numeric(
            scale(Age_years)
          ),
        storage_scaled =
          as.numeric(
            scale(
              Sample_age_days
            )
          )
      )

    continuous_fit <- lm(
      Factor_value ~
        clinical_scaled +
        age_scaled +
        storage_scaled,
      data = factor_data
    )

    clinical_coefficient <-
      broom::tidy(
        continuous_fit,
        conf.int = TRUE
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        term ==
          "clinical_scaled"
      )

    proteomics_continuous_results <-
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        proteomics_continuous_results,
        tibble::tibble(
          Factor = factor_name,
          parameter =
            clinical_parameter,
          n = nrow(factor_data),
          beta =
            clinical_coefficient$
              estimate,
          standard_error =
            clinical_coefficient$
              std.error,
          confidence_interval_low =
            clinical_coefficient$
              conf.low,
          confidence_interval_high =
            clinical_coefficient$
              conf.high,
          t_statistic =
            clinical_coefficient$
              statistic,
          p_value =
            clinical_coefficient$
              p.value,
          model_R2 =
            summary(
              continuous_fit
            )$r.squared,
          adjusted_model_R2 =
            summary(
              continuous_fit
            )$adj.r.squared
        )
      )
  }
}

proteomics_continuous_results <-
  proteomics_continuous_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(parameter) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR_within_parameter =
      p.adjust(
        p_value,
        method = "BH"
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR_global =
      p.adjust(
        p_value,
        method = "BH"
      ),
    parameter_label =
      unname(
        pretty_parameter_names[
          parameter
        ]
      )
  ) %>%

    FDR_global
  )
```

# Proteomics technical diagnostics

BCA is tested as a post hoc diagnostic. Its linear effect was removed from the Olink input matrix, but not from LC-MS/MS; associations with LC-MS/MS-dominant factors can therefore remain.

```{r proteomics technical diagnostic models}
proteomics_technical_results <-
  tibble::tibble()

technical_variables <- c(
  "BCA_mg_ml",
  "Age_years",
  "Sample_age_days"
)

for (
  factor_name in
  proteomics_factor_names
) {
  for (
    technical_variable in
    technical_variables
  ) {
    if (
      technical_variable ==
      "BCA_mg_ml"
    ) {
      technical_data <-
        proteomics_factor_scores %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          Factor == factor_name
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(
          Factor_value,
          BCA_mg_ml,
          Age_years,
          Sample_age_days
        ) %>%
        tidyr::drop_na() %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          technical_scaled =
            as.numeric(
              scale(BCA_mg_ml)
            ),
          age_scaled =
            as.numeric(
              scale(Age_years)
            ),
          storage_scaled =
            as.numeric(
              scale(
                Sample_age_days
              )
            )
        )

      technical_fit <- lm(
        Factor_value ~
          technical_scaled +
          age_scaled +
          storage_scaled,
        data = technical_data
      )
    } else if (
      technical_variable ==
      "Age_years"
    ) {
      technical_data <-
        proteomics_factor_scores %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          Factor == factor_name
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(
          Factor_value,
          Age_years,
          Sample_age_days
        ) %>%
        tidyr::drop_na() %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          technical_scaled =
            as.numeric(
              scale(Age_years)
            ),
          storage_scaled =
            as.numeric(
              scale(
                Sample_age_days
              )
            )
        )

      technical_fit <- lm(
        Factor_value ~
          technical_scaled +
          storage_scaled,
        data = technical_data
      )
    } else {
      technical_data <-
        proteomics_factor_scores %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          Factor == factor_name
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(
          Factor_value,
          Sample_age_days,
          Age_years
        ) %>%
        tidyr::drop_na() %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          technical_scaled =
            as.numeric(
              scale(
                Sample_age_days
              )
            ),
          age_scaled =
            as.numeric(
              scale(Age_years)
            )
        )

      technical_fit <- lm(
        Factor_value ~
          technical_scaled +
          age_scaled,
        data = technical_data
      )
    }

    technical_coefficient <-
      broom::tidy(
        technical_fit,
        conf.int = TRUE
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        term ==
          "technical_scaled"
      )

    proteomics_technical_results <-
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        proteomics_technical_results,
        tibble::tibble(
          Factor = factor_name,
          technical_variable =
            technical_variable,
          n = nrow(technical_data),
          beta =
            technical_coefficient$
              estimate,
          standard_error =
            technical_coefficient$
              std.error,
          confidence_interval_low =
            technical_coefficient$
              conf.low,
          confidence_interval_high =
            technical_coefficient$
              conf.high,
          p_value =
            technical_coefficient$
              p.value
        )
      )
  }
}

proteomics_technical_results <-
  proteomics_technical_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    technical_variable
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(

      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(FDR)

write.csv(
  proteomics_technical_results,
```

```{r proteomics Factor1 simplified GO GSEA barplot, fig.height=4.8, fig.width=6.05, dpi=300}
top_n_positive <- 8
top_n_negative <- 8
gsea_fdr_cutoff <- 0.05


wrap_gsea_labels <- function(
    x,
    width = 41
) {
  vapply(
    x,
    function(label) {
      label <-
        stringr::str_squish(
          as.character(label)
        )

      if (
        nchar(label) <= width
      ) {
        return(label)
      }

      words <-
        stringr::str_split(
          label,
          "\\s+"
        )[[1]]

      lines <- c(
        "",
        "",
        ""
      )

      current_line <- 1L

      for (
        word in words
      ) {
        candidate <-
          if (
            lines[current_line] == ""
          ) {
            word
          } else {
            paste(
              lines[current_line],
              word
            )
          }

        if (
          nchar(candidate) <= width
        ) {
          lines[current_line] <-
            candidate
        } else if (
          current_line < 3L
        ) {
          current_line <-
            current_line + 1L

          lines[current_line] <-
            word
        } else {
          lines[current_line] <-
            paste0(
              substr(
                lines[current_line],
                1,
                width - 1
              ),
              "…"
            )

          break
        }
      }

      if (
        nchar(lines[3]) > width
      ) {
        lines[3] <-
          paste0(
            substr(
              lines[3],
              1,
              width - 1
            ),
            "…"
          )
      }

      paste(
        lines[
          lines != ""
        ],
        collapse = "\n"
      )
    },
    FUN.VALUE = character(1)
  )
}


proteomics_factor1_go_gsea_simplified <-
  proteomics_factor1_gsea_simplified_objects[[
    "Factor1__GO_ALL"
  ]]


if (
  is.null(
    proteomics_factor1_go_gsea_simplified
  ) ||
  nrow(
    as.data.frame(
      proteomics_factor1_go_gsea_simplified
    )
  ) == 0L
) {
  message(
    "The simplified Factor 1 GO GSEA result is empty."
  )
} else {
  proteomics_factor1_go_gsea_results <-
    as.data.frame(
      proteomics_factor1_go_gsea_simplified
    ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(NES),
      !is.na(p.adjust),
      p.adjust <
        gsea_fdr_cutoff
    )

  if (
    nrow(
      proteomics_factor1_go_gsea_results
    ) == 0L
  ) {
    message(
      "No significant terms with FDR < ",
      gsea_fdr_cutoff,
      "."
    )
  } else {
    positive_terms <-
      proteomics_factor1_go_gsea_results %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        NES > 0
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        dplyr::desc(NES)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(
        n = top_n_positive
      )

    negative_terms <-
      proteomics_factor1_go_gsea_results %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        NES < 0
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(NES) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(
        n = top_n_negative
      )

    proteomics_factor1_go_gsea_plot_data <-
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        positive_terms,
        negative_terms
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Description_clean =
          stringr::str_remove(
            Description,
            "^\\[(BP|CC|MF)\\]\\s*"
          ),
        p_for_colour =
          dplyr::if_else(
            "pvalue" %in%
              colnames(
                proteomics_factor1_go_gsea_results
              ) &
              is.finite(pvalue) &
              pvalue > 0,
            pvalue,
            p.adjust
          ),
        colour_score =
          -log10(
            pmax(
              p_for_colour,
              .Machine$double.xmin
            )
          ) *
          sign(NES),
        Description_wrapped =
          wrap_gsea_labels(
            Description_clean,
            width = 41
          )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(NES) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Description_wrapped =
          factor(
            Description_wrapped,
            levels =
              unique(
                Description_wrapped
              )
          )
      )

    colour_limit <-
      unname(
        stats::quantile(
          abs(
            proteomics_factor1_go_gsea_plot_data$
              colour_score
          ),
          probs = 0.80,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      )

    if (
      !is.finite(colour_limit) ||
      colour_limit == 0
    ) {
      colour_limit <-
        max(
          abs(
            proteomics_factor1_go_gsea_plot_data$
              colour_score
          ),
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
    }

    proteomics_factor1_go_gsea_plot <-
      ggplot(
        proteomics_factor1_go_gsea_plot_data,
        aes(
          x =
            Description_wrapped,
          y = NES,
          fill =
            colour_score
        )
      ) +
      geom_col(
        width = 0.9
      ) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "#004C8C",
        mid = "white",
        high = "#A63A2A",
        midpoint = 0,
        limits = c(
          -colour_limit,
          colour_limit
        ),
        oob =
          scales::squish,
        name =
          expression(
            -log[10](p) %*% sign(NES)
          )
      ) +
      labs(
        title =
          "Proteomics | GSEA | Gene Ontology",
        x = NULL,
        y =
          "Normalized enrichment score (NES)"
      ) +
      theme_bw(
        base_size = 10
      ) +
      theme(
        text =
          element_text(
            color = "black"
          ),
        plot.title =
          element_text(
            hjust = 0.5,
            face = "bold",
            size = 11
          ),
        axis.text =
          element_text(
            color = "black"
          ),
        axis.title.x =
          element_text(
            color = "black",
            size = 12
          ),
        axis.text.y =
          element_text(
            size = 10.2,
            color = "black",
            lineheight = 0.6
          ),
        panel.grid.minor =
          element_blank(),
        legend.position =
          "bottom",
        legend.direction =
          "horizontal",
        legend.title =
          element_text(
            size = 9
          ),
        legend.text =
          element_text(
            size = 9
          )
      ) +
      guides(
        fill =
          guide_colorbar(
            barwidth =
              grid::unit(
                6,
                "cm"
              ),
            barheight =
              grid::unit(
                0.3,
                "cm"
              ),
            title.position =
              "top",
            title.hjust = 0.5
          )
      )

    proteomics_factor1_go_gsea_plot
  }
}
```

## Factor 1 core-enrichment features

```{r proteomics Factor1 selected GSEA core genes}
factor1_go_gsea <-
  proteomics_factor1_gsea$
    objects[[
      "Factor1__GO_ALL"
    ]]

if (is.null(factor1_go_gsea)) {
  stop(
    "The Factor1 GO GSEA object was not found."
  )
}

factor1_orientation <-
  proteomics_gsea_factor_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Factor == "Factor1"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(
    orientation
  )

if (
  length(factor1_orientation) != 1L
) {
  factor1_orientation <- 1
}

factor1_go_gsea_table <-
  as.data.frame(
    factor1_go_gsea
  ) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Description_clean =
      stringr::str_remove(
        Description,
        "^\\[(BP|CC|MF)\\]\\s*"
      ),
    Description_key =
      stringr::str_to_lower(
        Description_clean
      )
  )

target_gsea_terms <-
  factor1_go_gsea_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Description_key %in%
      c(
        "immune response",
        "oxidative phosphorylation"
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Description_key
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(
    order_by = p.adjust,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

if (
  nrow(target_gsea_terms) != 2L
) {
  stop(
    "One or both selected GSEA terms were not found."
  )
}

target_core_genes <-
  purrr::map_dfr(
    seq_len(
      nrow(
        target_gsea_terms
      )
    ),
    function(term_index) {
      core_entrez <-
        stringr::str_split(
          target_gsea_terms$
            core_enrichment[
              term_index
            ],
          pattern = "/"
        )[[1]]

      core_mapping <-
        bitr(
          core_entrez,
          fromType = "ENTREZID",
          toType = "SYMBOL",
          OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
        ) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(
          ENTREZID,
          SYMBOL
        )

      core_mapping %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          GSEA_term =
            target_gsea_terms$
              Description_clean[
                term_index
              ],
          GO_ID =
            target_gsea_terms$
              ID[
                term_index
              ],
          NES =
            target_gsea_terms$
              NES[
                term_index
              ],
          GSEA_p_value =
            target_gsea_terms$
              pvalue[
                term_index
              ],
          GSEA_FDR =
            target_gsea_terms$
              p.adjust[
                term_index
              ],
          ENTREZID,
          Feature = SYMBOL
        )
    }
  )

factor1_proteomics_weights <-
  proteomics_factor_weights %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Factor == "Factor1",
    View %in%
      c(
        "Olink",
        "LCMS"
      ),
    is.finite(Weight)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Feature =
      clean_mofa_feature_name(
        Feature
      ),
    Modality =
      standardise_mofa_view_name(
        View
      ),
    Oriented_weight =
      Weight *
      factor1_orientation
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    View
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Scaled_weight =
      Oriented_weight /
      max(
        abs(
          Oriented_weight
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

factor1_core_feature_table <-
  target_core_genes %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    factor1_proteomics_weights,
    by = "Feature"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Sign_consistent =
      sign(
        Scaled_weight
      ) ==
      sign(
        NES
      ),
    Directional_score =
      Scaled_weight *
      sign(
        NES
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    GSEA_term,
    dplyr::desc(
      Directional_score
    )
  )

factor1_core_top5_per_view <-
  factor1_core_feature_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Sign_consistent
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    GSEA_term,
    View
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(
    order_by =
      Directional_score,
    n = 5,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Rank_within_term_and_view =
      dplyr::row_number()
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    GSEA_term,
    View,
    Rank_within_term_and_view
  )

write.csv(
  factor1_core_feature_table,
  file.path(
    proteomics_output_dir,
    "MOFA_proteomics_Factor1_selected_GSEA_all_core_features.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  factor1_core_top5_per_view,
  file.path(
    proteomics_output_dir,
    "MOFA_proteomics_Factor1_selected_GSEA_top5_per_view.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r proteomics Factor1 selected GSEA heatmap, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
extract_factor1_gsea_heatmap_matrix <- function(
    feature_table,
    data_views,
    sample_order
) {
  extracted_rows <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = nrow(feature_table)
  )

  row_found <- logical(
    nrow(feature_table)
  )

  resolved_features <- character(
    nrow(feature_table)
  )

  for (
    feature_index in
    seq_len(nrow(feature_table))
  ) {
    current_view <-
      as.character(
        feature_table$View[
          feature_index
        ]
      )

    current_feature <-
      as.character(
        feature_table$Feature[
          feature_index
        ]
      )

    if (
      !current_view %in%
        names(data_views)
    ) {
      next
    }

    feature_candidates <- unique(
      c(
        current_feature,

        paste0(
          current_feature,
          "_",
          current_view
        ),

        paste0(
          current_feature,
          "_",
          dplyr::case_when(
            current_view == "Olink" ~
              "OLINK",

            current_view == "LCMS" ~
              "MS",

            TRUE ~
              current_view
          )
        )
      )
    )

    resolved_feature <-
      feature_candidates[
        feature_candidates %in%
          rownames(
            data_views[[
              current_view
            ]]
          )
      ][1]

    if (
      length(resolved_feature) == 0L ||
      is.na(resolved_feature)
    ) {
      next
    }

    extracted_rows[[
      feature_index
    ]] <-
      as.numeric(
        data_views[[
          current_view
        ]][
          resolved_feature,
          sample_order,
          drop = TRUE
        ]
      )

    resolved_features[
      feature_index
    ] <- resolved_feature

    row_found[
      feature_index
    ] <- TRUE
  }

  if (!any(row_found)) {
    stop(
      "None of the selected features were found in the proteomics matrices."
    )
  }

  if (any(!row_found)) {
    warning(
      "The following selected features were not found and were omitted: ",
      paste(
        paste0(
          feature_table$Feature[
            !row_found
          ],
          " (",
          feature_table$View[
            !row_found
          ],
          ")"
        ),
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  retained_feature_table <-
    feature_table[
      row_found,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ] %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Resolved_feature =
        resolved_features[
          row_found
        ],

      Display_feature =
        Feature,

      Modality =
        dplyr::case_when(
          View == "Olink" ~
            "OLINK",

          View == "LCMS" ~
            "MS",

          TRUE ~
            as.character(View)
        ),

      Internal_row_id =
        make.unique(
          paste(
            Pathway,
            View,
            Feature,
            sep = "__"
          )
        )
    )

  expression_matrix <-
    do.call(
      rbind,
      extracted_rows[
        row_found
      ]
    )

  colnames(expression_matrix) <-
    sample_order

  rownames(expression_matrix) <-
    retained_feature_table$
      Internal_row_id

  list(
    matrix =
      expression_matrix,

    feature_table =
      retained_feature_table
  )
}


prepare_factor1_gsea_heatmap_z_scores <- function(
    expression_matrix
) {
  imputed_matrix <-
    expression_matrix

  for (
    row_index in
    seq_len(nrow(imputed_matrix))
  ) {
    row_values <-
      imputed_matrix[
        row_index,
        ,
        drop = TRUE
      ]

    finite_values <-
      row_values[
        is.finite(row_values)
      ]

    if (
      length(finite_values) == 0L
    ) {
      next
    }

    row_values[
      !is.finite(row_values)
    ] <-
      stats::median(
        finite_values
      )

    imputed_matrix[
      row_index,
    ] <- row_values
  }

  row_means <-
    rowMeans(
      imputed_matrix,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

  row_standard_deviations <-
    apply(
      imputed_matrix,
      1,
      stats::sd,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

  row_standard_deviations[
    !is.finite(
      row_standard_deviations
    ) |
      row_standard_deviations == 0
  ] <- 1

  z_score_matrix <-
    sweep(
      imputed_matrix,
      1,
      row_means,
      "-"
    )

  z_score_matrix <-
    sweep(
      z_score_matrix,
      1,
      row_standard_deviations,
      "/"
    )

  pmax(
    pmin(
      z_score_matrix,
      2
    ),
    -2
  )
}


make_grey_annotation_scale <- function(
    values,
    dark_at = c(
      "low",
      "high"
    )
) {
  dark_at <-
    match.arg(
      dark_at
    )

  finite_values <-
    values[
      is.finite(values)
    ]

  value_range <-
    if (
      length(finite_values) == 0L
    ) {
      c(0, 1)
    } else {
      range(
        finite_values,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }

  if (
    value_range[1] ==
      value_range[2]
  ) {
    value_range <-
      value_range +
      c(
        -0.5,
        0.5
      )
  }

  annotation_colours <-
    if (
      dark_at == "low"
    ) {
      c(
        "grey10",
        "grey95"
      )
    } else {
      c(
        "grey95",
        "grey10"
      )
    }

  circlize::colorRamp2(
    value_range,
    annotation_colours
  )
}
```

# Preprocess pseudobulk snRNA-seq

The RNA view is needed only for the matched three-view model. Genes are retained when detected in at least 1% of nuclei from the DCM samples, pseudobulk counts are aggregated per patient, DESeq2 VST is applied, and the 2,000 most variable transformed genes are selected.

## Read the Seurat object

```{r read snrna object}
DCM_RV <- qs2::qs_read(
  seurat_file,
  nthreads = n_qs_threads
)

DefaultAssay(DCM_RV) <- "RNA"
DCM_RV$pseudobulk <- "Pseudobulk"
```

## Filter genes using DCM nuclei

```{r rna nucleus level gene filtering}
dcm_cells <- colnames(DCM_RV)[
  DCM_RV$Sample %in%
    clin_all$Sample
]

rna_counts <- SeuratObject::LayerData(
  DCM_RV,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "counts"
)[
  ,
  dcm_cells,
  drop = FALSE
]

n_rna_nuclei <- ncol(rna_counts)

minimum_nuclei <- ceiling(
  rna_min_nuclei_fraction *
    n_rna_nuclei
)

rna_nuclei_detected <-
  Matrix::rowSums(
    rna_counts > 0
  )

rna_detection_table <-
  tibble::tibble(
    feature = rownames(rna_counts),
    n_nuclei_detected =
      as.numeric(
        rna_nuclei_detected
      ),
    fraction_nuclei_detected =
      as.numeric(
        rna_nuclei_detected
      ) /
      n_rna_nuclei,
    passes_1_percent_filter =
      n_nuclei_detected >=
      minimum_nuclei
  )

if (
  exclude_mitochondrial_and_ribosomal_genes
) {
  rna_detection_table <-
    rna_detection_table %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      mitochondrial_or_ribosomal =
        grepl(
          "^MT-|^RP[SL]",
          feature
        ),
      retained_before_VST =
        passes_1_percent_filter &
        !mitochondrial_or_ribosomal
    )
} else {
  rna_detection_table <-
    rna_detection_table %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      mitochondrial_or_ribosomal =
        FALSE,
      retained_before_VST =
        passes_1_percent_filter
    )
}

rna_genes_for_pseudobulk <-
  rna_detection_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    retained_before_VST
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(feature)

write.csv(
  rna_detection_table,
  file.path(
    preprocessing_output_dir,
    "RNA_nucleus_detection_filter.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

c(
  nuclei = n_rna_nuclei,
  minimum_nuclei = minimum_nuclei,
  retained_genes =
    length(
      rna_genes_for_pseudobulk
    )
)
```

## Generate sample-level pseudobulk counts

```{r create rna pseudobulk}
rna_pb <- edgeR::Seurat2PB(
  DCM_RV,
  sample = "Sample",
  cluster = "pseudobulk"
)

colnames(rna_pb) <-
  rna_pb$samples$sample

rna_samples <- intersect(
  clin_all$Sample,
  colnames(rna_pb)
)

rna_pb <- rna_pb[
  ,
  rna_samples,
  keep.lib.sizes = FALSE
]

keep_rna_samples <-
  rna_pb$samples$lib.size >
  min_rna_library_size

rna_pb <- rna_pb[
  ,
  keep_rna_samples,
  keep.lib.sizes = FALSE
]

rna_genes_for_pseudobulk <-
  intersect(
    rna_genes_for_pseudobulk,
    rownames(rna_pb)
  )

rna_pb <- rna_pb[
  rna_genes_for_pseudobulk,
  ,
  keep.lib.sizes = FALSE
]

rm(rna_counts)
gc()

dim(rna_pb)
```

## Apply VST and select 2,000 variable genes

```{r vst transform rna pseudobulk}
rna_count_matrix <-
  as.matrix(
    rna_pb$counts
  )

storage.mode(
  rna_count_matrix
) <- "integer"

rna_coldata <- data.frame(
  Sample =
    colnames(
      rna_count_matrix
    ),
  row.names =
    colnames(
      rna_count_matrix
    )
)

rna_dds <-
  DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData =
      rna_count_matrix,
    colData =
      rna_coldata,
    design = ~ 1
  )

rna_vst_object <-
  DESeq2::vst(
    rna_dds,
    blind = TRUE
  )

rna_vst_matrix <-
  SummarizedExperiment::assay(
    rna_vst_object
  )

rna_variance <-
  matrixStats::rowVars(
    rna_vst_matrix
  )

keep_finite_rna_variance <-
  is.finite(rna_variance) &
  rna_variance > 0

rna_vst_matrix <-
  rna_vst_matrix[
    keep_finite_rna_variance,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

rna_variance <-
  rna_variance[
    keep_finite_rna_variance
  ]

rna_feature_order <- order(
  rna_variance,
  decreasing = TRUE
)

rna_feature_order <- head(
  rna_feature_order,
  min(
    n_rna_features,
    length(
      rna_feature_order
    )
  )
)

rna_mofa <-
  rna_vst_matrix[
    rna_feature_order,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

rna_feature_table <-
  tibble::tibble(
    feature =
      rownames(
        rna_vst_matrix
      ),
    VST_variance =
      as.numeric(
        rna_variance
      ),
    selected_for_MOFA =
      rownames(
        rna_vst_matrix
      ) %in%
      rownames(rna_mofa)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(
      VST_variance
    )
  )

write.csv(
  rna_feature_table,
  file.path(
    preprocessing_output_dir,
    "RNA_VST_feature_selection.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  list(
    RNA_pseudobulk = rna_mofa,
    RNA_VST_all_filtered_genes =
      rna_vst_matrix,
    feature_table =
      rna_feature_table
  ),
  processed_rna_file
)

dim(rna_mofa)
```

# Model 2: matched RNA, Olink and LC-MS/MS

Only patients measured in all three modalities are included. This model is used to evaluate whether major factors are shared between transcriptomic and proteomic layers.

## Tune the number of matched-model factors

```{r tune matched factor number, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
matched_tuning_results <-
  tibble::tibble()

for (n_factors in candidate_factors) {
  for (tuning_seed in tuning_seeds) {
    tuning_model_file <- file.path(
      matched_output_dir,
      paste0(
        "MOFA_matched_tuning_K",
        sprintf("%02d", n_factors),
        "_seed",
        tuning_seed,
        ".hdf5"
      )
    )

    if (file.exists(tuning_model_file)) {
      unlink(tuning_model_file)
    }

    message(
      "Starting matched model: K = ",
      n_factors,
      ", seed = ",
      tuning_seed
    )

    tuning_object <- MOFA2::create_mofa(
      matched_data
    )

    tuning_data_options <-
      MOFA2::get_default_data_options(
        tuning_object
      )

    tuning_data_options$scale_views <- TRUE

    tuning_model_options <-
      MOFA2::get_default_model_options(
        tuning_object
      )

    tuning_model_options$num_factors <-
      n_factors

    tuning_model_options$likelihoods[] <-
      "gaussian"

    tuning_training_options <-
      MOFA2::get_default_training_options(
        tuning_object
      )

    tuning_training_options$maxiter <-
      tuning_maxiter

    tuning_training_options$convergence_mode <-
      mofa_convergence_mode

    tuning_training_options$freqELBO <-
      mofa_freq_elbo

    tuning_training_options$drop_factor_threshold <-
      -1

    tuning_training_options$seed <-
      tuning_seed

    tuning_training_options$verbose <-
      FALSE

    tuning_object <- MOFA2::prepare_mofa(
      object = tuning_object,
      data_options =
        tuning_data_options,
      model_options =
        tuning_model_options,
      training_options =
        tuning_training_options
    )

    MOFA2::run_mofa(
      tuning_object,
      outfile = tuning_model_file,
      use_basilisk = TRUE
    )

    rm(tuning_object)
    gc()

    tuning_model <- MOFA2::load_model(
      tuning_model_file,
      sort_factors = TRUE,
      remove_inactive_factors = FALSE
    )

    tuning_r2 <-
      MOFA2::get_variance_explained(
        tuning_model
      )$r2_per_factor[[1]]

    weakest_factor <-
      tail(
        rownames(tuning_r2),
        1
      )

    weakest_factor_r2 <-
      tuning_r2[
        weakest_factor,
        ,
        drop = TRUE
      ]

    new_tuning_result <- tibble::tibble(
      n_factors = n_factors,
      seed = tuning_seed,
      final_ELBO =
        MOFA2::get_elbo(tuning_model),
      weakest_factor = weakest_factor,
      weakest_factor_total_R2 =
        sum(
          weakest_factor_r2,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
      weakest_factor_RNA_R2 =
        unname(
          weakest_factor_r2[
            "RNA_pseudobulk"
          ]
        ),
      weakest_factor_Olink_R2 =
        unname(
          weakest_factor_r2[
            "Olink"
          ]
        ),
      weakest_factor_LCMS_R2 =
        unname(
          weakest_factor_r2[
            "LCMS"
          ]
        ),
      n_factors_total_R2_at_least_cutoff =
        sum(
          rowSums(
            tuning_r2,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ) >= last_factor_r2_cutoff
        ),
      model_file = tuning_model_file
    )

    matched_tuning_results <-
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        matched_tuning_results,
        new_tuning_result
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        n_factors,
        seed
      )

    write.csv(
      matched_tuning_results,
      matched_tuning_summary_file,
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    message(
      "Finished matched model: K = ",
      n_factors,
      ", seed = ",
      tuning_seed
    )

    rm(tuning_model)
    gc()
  }
}

matched_tuning_results
```

## Select the matched-model factor number

```{r select matched best tuning run per K}
matched_best_tuning_runs <-
  matched_tuning_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(n_factors) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(
    order_by = final_ELBO,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(n_factors)

write.csv(
  matched_best_tuning_runs,
  matched_best_tuning_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

matched_low_weakest_factor <-
  matched_best_tuning_runs$
    weakest_factor_total_R2 <
  last_factor_r2_cutoff

matched_low_runs <- vapply(
  seq_along(
    matched_low_weakest_factor
  ),
  function(i) {
    end_i <-
      i +
      n_consecutive_low_models -
      1

    end_i <=
      length(
        matched_low_weakest_factor
      ) &&
      all(
        matched_low_weakest_factor[
          i:end_i
        ]
      )
  },
  logical(1)
)

matched_first_low_run <-
  which(matched_low_runs)[1]

if (
  length(matched_first_low_run) == 1 &&
  !is.na(matched_first_low_run)
) {
  matched_selected_n_factors <- max(
    matched_best_tuning_runs$
      n_factors[
        matched_first_low_run
      ] - 1,
    min(candidate_factors)
  )

  matched_factor_plateau_reached <-
    TRUE
} else {
  matched_selected_n_factors <-
    max(candidate_factors)

  matched_factor_plateau_reached <-
    FALSE

  warning(
    paste0(
      "No sequence of ",
      n_consecutive_low_models,
      " consecutive matched models with weakest-factor variance below ",
      last_factor_r2_cutoff,
      "% was observed. The maximum tested factor number was selected."
    )
  )
}

matched_selected_seed <-
  matched_best_tuning_runs %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n_factors ==
      matched_selected_n_factors
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(seed)

matched_selected_model_settings <-
  tibble::tibble(
    selected_n_factors =
      matched_selected_n_factors,
    selected_seed =
      matched_selected_seed,
    factor_plateau_reached =
      matched_factor_plateau_reached,
    weakest_factor_R2_cutoff =
      last_factor_r2_cutoff,
    consecutive_low_models_required =
      n_consecutive_low_models,
    tuning_maxiter = tuning_maxiter,
    final_maxiter = final_maxiter,
    convergence_mode =
      mofa_convergence_mode
  )

write.csv(
  matched_selected_model_settings,
  matched_selected_settings_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

matched_selected_model_settings
```

## Quantify RNA-specific, proteomics-specific and shared factors

```{r matched factor layer structure}
matched_factor_layer_table <-
  matched_r2_per_factor_table %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = View,
    values_from = R2,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Proteomics_R2 =
      Olink + LCMS,
    Total_R2 =
      RNA_pseudobulk +
      Proteomics_R2,
    RNA_fraction =
      dplyr::if_else(
        Total_R2 > 0,
        RNA_pseudobulk /
          Total_R2,
        NA_real_
      ),
    Proteomics_fraction =
      dplyr::if_else(
        Total_R2 > 0,
        Proteomics_R2 /
          Total_R2,
        NA_real_
      ),
    Meaningful_RNA_and_proteomics =
      RNA_pseudobulk >=
        matched_shared_r2_cutoff &
      Proteomics_R2 >=
        matched_shared_r2_cutoff
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(Total_R2)
  )

write.csv(
  matched_factor_layer_table,
  file.path(
    matched_output_dir,
    "MOFA_matched_factor_layer_structure.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

  searchable = TRUE,

)
```

```{r matched group association models}
matched_group_global_results <-
  tibble::tibble()

matched_group_pairwise_results <-
  tibble::tibble()

for (
  factor_name in
  matched_factor_names
) {
  factor_data <-
    matched_factor_scores %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Factor == factor_name,
      RV_group %in%
        rv_group_comparison_levels
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Sample,
      Factor_value,
      RV_group,
      Age_years,
      Sample_age_days
    ) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      RV_group = factor(
        as.character(RV_group),
        levels =
          rv_group_comparison_levels
      )
    ) %>%
    droplevels()

  if (
    nlevels(factor_data$RV_group) < 2L
  ) {
    next
  }

  group_counts <-
    table(
      factor_data$RV_group
    )

  group_fit <- lm(
    Factor_value ~
      RV_group +
      scale(Age_years) +
      scale(Sample_age_days),
    data = factor_data
  )

  group_test <- drop1(
    group_fit,
    test = "F"
  )

  matched_group_global_results <-
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      matched_group_global_results,
      tibble::tibble(
        Factor = factor_name,
        comparison =
          "Compensated versus Decompensated",
        n = nrow(factor_data),
        n_compensated =
          unname(
            group_counts["Compensated"]
          ),
        n_decompensated =
          unname(
            group_counts["Decompensated"]
          ),
        F_statistic =
          group_test[
            "RV_group",
            "F value"
          ],
        p_value =
          group_test[
            "RV_group",
            "Pr(>F)"
          ],
        model_R2 =
          summary(group_fit)$r.squared,
        adjusted_model_R2 =
          summary(group_fit)$adj.r.squared
      )
    )

  factor_emmeans <- emmeans::emmeans(
    group_fit,
    ~ RV_group
  )

  factor_contrasts <-
    emmeans::contrast(
      factor_emmeans,
      method = list(
        "Decompensated - Compensated" =
          c(-1, 1)
      ),
      adjust = "none"
    ) %>%
    summary(
      infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
    ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Factor = factor_name,
      n = nrow(factor_data),
      n_compensated =
        unname(
          group_counts["Compensated"]
        ),
      n_decompensated =
        unname(
          group_counts["Decompensated"]
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Factor,
      contrast,
      estimate,
      SE,
      df,
      lower.CL,
      upper.CL,
      t.ratio,
      p.value,
      n,
      n_compensated,
      n_decompensated
    )

  matched_group_pairwise_results <-
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      matched_group_pairwise_results,
      factor_contrasts
    )
}

matched_group_global_results <-
  matched_group_global_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(FDR)

matched_group_pairwise_results <-
  matched_group_pairwise_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(
      p.value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(FDR)

write.csv(
  matched_group_global_results,
  file.path(
    matched_output_dir,
    "MOFA_matched_factors_compensated_vs_decompensated_global.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
```

# Matched-model associations with continuous clinical parameters

```{r matched continuous clinical association models}
matched_continuous_results <-
  tibble::tibble()

for (
  factor_name in
  matched_factor_names
) {
  for (
    clinical_parameter in
    clinical_parameters
  ) {
    factor_data <-
      matched_factor_scores %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Factor == factor_name
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Sample,
        Factor_value,
        Age_years,
        Sample_age_days,
        dplyr::all_of(
          clinical_parameter
        )
      ) %>%
      tidyr::drop_na()

    factor_data <- factor_data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        clinical_scaled =
          as.numeric(
            scale(
              .data[[clinical_parameter]]
            )
          ),
        age_scaled =
          as.numeric(
            scale(Age_years)
          ),
        storage_scaled =
          as.numeric(
            scale(
              Sample_age_days
            )
          )
      )

    continuous_fit <- lm(
      Factor_value ~
        clinical_scaled +
        age_scaled +
        storage_scaled,
      data = factor_data
    )

    clinical_coefficient <-
      broom::tidy(
        continuous_fit,
        conf.int = TRUE
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        term ==
          "clinical_scaled"
      )

    matched_continuous_results <-
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        matched_continuous_results,
        tibble::tibble(
          Factor = factor_name,
          parameter =
            clinical_parameter,
          n = nrow(factor_data),
          beta =
            clinical_coefficient$
              estimate,
          standard_error =
            clinical_coefficient$
              std.error,
          confidence_interval_low =
            clinical_coefficient$
              conf.low,
          confidence_interval_high =
            clinical_coefficient$
              conf.high,
          t_statistic =
            clinical_coefficient$
              statistic,
          p_value =
            clinical_coefficient$
              p.value,
          model_R2 =
            summary(
              continuous_fit
            )$r.squared,
          adjusted_model_R2 =
            summary(
              continuous_fit
            )$adj.r.squared
        )
      )
  }
}

matched_continuous_results <-
  matched_continuous_results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(parameter) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR_within_parameter =
      p.adjust(
        p_value,
        method = "BH"
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR_global =
      p.adjust(
        p_value,
        method = "BH"
      ),
    parameter_label =
      unname(
        pretty_parameter_names[
          parameter
        ]
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    FDR_global
  )

write.csv(
  matched_continuous_results,
  file.path(
    matched_output_dir,
    "MOFA_matched_factors_vs_continuous_clinical_parameters.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
