```{r matched Factor2 fibrosis custom heatmap, fig.height=9, fig.width=10}
extract_matched_factor2_heatmap_matrix <- function(
    feature_table,
    data_views,
    sample_order
) {
  extracted_rows <- vector(
    mode = "list",
    length = nrow(
      feature_table
    )
  )

  row_found <- logical(
    nrow(
      feature_table
    )
  )

  resolved_features <- character(
    nrow(
      feature_table
    )
  )

  for (
    feature_index in
    seq_len(
      nrow(
        feature_table
      )
    )
  ) {
    current_view <-
      as.character(
        feature_table$View[
          feature_index
        ]
      )

    current_feature <-
      as.character(
        feature_table$Feature_actual[
          feature_index
        ]
      )

    if (
      !current_view %in%
        names(
          data_views
        )
    ) {
      next
    }

    feature_candidates <- unique(
      c(
        current_feature,

        as.character(
          feature_table$Feature[
            feature_index
          ]
        ),

        paste0(
          as.character(
            feature_table$Feature[
              feature_index
            ]
          ),
          "_",
          current_view
        ),

        paste0(
          as.character(
            feature_table$Feature[
              feature_index
            ]
          ),
          "_",
          dplyr::case_when(
            current_view == "Olink" ~
              "OLINK",

            current_view == "LCMS" ~
              "MS",

            current_view == "RNA_pseudobulk" ~
              "RNA_pseudobulk",

            TRUE ~
              current_view
          )
        )
      )
    )

    resolved_feature <-
      feature_candidates[
        feature_candidates %in%
          rownames(
            data_views[[
              current_view
            ]]
          )
      ][1]

    if (
      length(
        resolved_feature
      ) == 0L ||
      is.na(
        resolved_feature
      )
    ) {
      next
    }

    extracted_rows[[
      feature_index
    ]] <-
      as.numeric(
        data_views[[
          current_view
        ]][
          resolved_feature,
          sample_order,
          drop = TRUE
        ]
      )

    resolved_features[
      feature_index
    ] <-
      resolved_feature

    row_found[
      feature_index
    ] <-
      TRUE
  }


  if (
    !any(
      row_found
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      "None of the selected matched-model features were found in matched_data."
    )
  }


  if (
    any(
      !row_found
    )
  ) {
    warning(
      "The following selected features were not found and were omitted: ",
      paste(
        paste0(
          feature_table$Feature[
            !row_found
          ],
          " (",
          feature_table$View[
            !row_found
          ],
          ")"
        ),
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }


  retained_feature_table <-
    feature_table[
      row_found,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ] %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Resolved_feature =
        resolved_features[
          row_found
        ],

      Display_feature =
        Feature,

      Internal_row_id =
        make.unique(
          paste(
            Annotation,
            View,
            Feature,
            sep = "__"
          )
        )
    )


  expression_matrix <-
    do.call(
      rbind,
      extracted_rows[
        row_found
      ]
    )


  colnames(
    expression_matrix
  ) <-
    sample_order


  rownames(
    expression_matrix
  ) <-
    retained_feature_table$
      Internal_row_id


  list(
    matrix =
      expression_matrix,

    feature_table =
      retained_feature_table
  )
}


prepare_matched_heatmap_z_scores <- function(
    expression_matrix
) {
  imputed_matrix <-
    expression_matrix


  for (
    row_index in
    seq_len(
      nrow(
        imputed_matrix
      )
    )
  ) {
    row_values <-
      imputed_matrix[
        row_index,
        ,
        drop = TRUE
      ]


    finite_values <-
      row_values[
        is.finite(
          row_values
        )
      ]


    if (
      length(
        finite_values
      ) == 0L
    ) {
      next
    }


    row_values[
      !is.finite(
        row_values
      )
    ] <-
      stats::median(
        finite_values
      )


    imputed_matrix[
      row_index,
    ] <-
      row_values
  }


  row_means <-
    rowMeans(
      imputed_matrix,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )


  row_standard_deviations <-
    apply(
      imputed_matrix,
      1,
      stats::sd,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )


  row_standard_deviations[
    !is.finite(
      row_standard_deviations
    ) |
      row_standard_deviations == 0
  ] <- 1


  z_score_matrix <-
    sweep(
      imputed_matrix,
      1,
      row_means,
      "-"
    )


  z_score_matrix <-
    sweep(
      z_score_matrix,
      1,
      row_standard_deviations,
      "/"
    )


  pmax(
    pmin(
      z_score_matrix,
      2
    ),
    -2
  )
}


make_fibrosis_grey_scale <- function(
    values
) {
  finite_values <-
    values[
      is.finite(
        values
      )
    ]


  value_range <-
    if (
      length(
        finite_values
      ) == 0L
    ) {
      c(
        0,
        1
      )
    } else {
      range(
        finite_values,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }


  if (
    value_range[1] ==
      value_range[2]
  ) {
    value_range <-
      value_range +
      c(
        -0.5,
        0.5
      )
  }


  circlize::colorRamp2(
    value_range,
    c(
      "grey95",
      "grey10"
    )
  )
}
```

# Matched Factor 2 gene set enrichment analysis

Factor 2 was analysed separately in the transcriptomic and proteomic layers. RNA pseudobulk weights were analysed directly, while Olink and LC-MS/MS weights were scaled within each platform before aggregation.


```{r matched Factor2 simplified GO GSEA plots, fig.height=4.8, fig.width=12.1, dpi=300}
factor2_gsea_top_positive <- 8
factor2_gsea_top_negative <- 8
factor2_gsea_fdr_cutoff <- 0.05


wrap_factor2_gsea_labels <- function(
    x,
    width = 41
) {
  vapply(
    x,
    function(label) {
      label <-
        stringr::str_squish(
          as.character(label)
        )

      if (
        nchar(label) <= width
      ) {
        return(label)
      }

      words <-
        stringr::str_split(
          label,
          "\\s+"
        )[[1]]

      lines <- c(
        "",
        "",
        ""
      )

      current_line <- 1L

      for (
        word in words
      ) {
        candidate <-
          if (
            lines[current_line] == ""
          ) {
            word
          } else {
            paste(
              lines[current_line],
              word
            )
          }

        if (
          nchar(candidate) <= width
        ) {
          lines[current_line] <-
            candidate
        } else if (
          current_line < 3L
        ) {
          current_line <-
            current_line + 1L

          lines[current_line] <-
            word
        } else {
          lines[current_line] <-
            paste0(
              substr(
                lines[current_line],
                1,
                width - 1
              ),
              "…"
            )

          break
        }
      }

      if (
        nchar(lines[3]) > width
      ) {
        lines[3] <-
          paste0(
            substr(
              lines[3],
              1,
              width - 1
            ),
            "…"
          )
      }

      paste(
        lines[
          lines != ""
        ],
        collapse = "\n"
      )
    },
    FUN.VALUE = character(1)
  )
}


make_factor2_simplified_gsea_plot <- function(
    gsea_object,
    layer_label
) {
  if (
    is.null(gsea_object) ||
    nrow(
      as.data.frame(
        gsea_object
      )
    ) == 0L
  ) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        annotate(
          "text",
          x = 1,
          y = 1,
          label =
            "No GSEA results"
        ) +
        labs(
          title =
            paste0(
              layer_label,
              " | GSEA | Gene Ontology"
            )
        ) +
        theme_void()
    )
  }

  gsea_results <-
    as.data.frame(
      gsea_object
    ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(NES),
      is.finite(p.adjust),
      p.adjust <
        factor2_gsea_fdr_cutoff
    )

  if (
    nrow(gsea_results) == 0L
  ) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        annotate(
          "text",
          x = 1,
          y = 1,
          label =
            paste0(
              "No terms with FDR < ",
              factor2_gsea_fdr_cutoff
            )
        ) +
        labs(
          title =
            paste0(
              layer_label,
              " | GSEA | Gene Ontology"
            )
        ) +
        theme_void()
    )
  }

  positive_terms <-
    gsea_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      NES > 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(NES)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(
      n =
        factor2_gsea_top_positive
    )

  negative_terms <-
    gsea_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      NES < 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(NES) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(
      n =
        factor2_gsea_top_negative
    )

  plot_data <-
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      positive_terms,
      negative_terms
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Description_clean =
        stringr::str_remove(
          Description,
          "^\\[(BP|CC|MF)\\]\\s*"
        )
    )

  if (
    "pvalue" %in%
      colnames(plot_data)
  ) {
    plot_data <-
      plot_data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        p_for_colour =
          dplyr::if_else(
            is.finite(pvalue) &
              pvalue > 0,
            pvalue,
            p.adjust
          )
      )
  } else {
    plot_data <-
      plot_data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        p_for_colour =
          p.adjust
      )
  }

  plot_data <-
    plot_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      colour_score =
        -log10(
          pmax(
            p_for_colour,
            .Machine$double.xmin
          )
        ) *
        sign(NES),

      Description_wrapped =
        wrap_factor2_gsea_labels(
          Description_clean,
          width = 41
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(NES) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Description_wrapped =
        factor(
          Description_wrapped,
          levels =
            unique(
              Description_wrapped
            )
        )
    )

  colour_limit <-
    unname(
      stats::quantile(
        abs(
          plot_data$
            colour_score
        ),
        probs = 0.80,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )

  if (
    length(colour_limit) != 1L ||
    !is.finite(colour_limit) ||
    colour_limit == 0
  ) {
    colour_limit <-
      max(
        abs(
          plot_data$
            colour_score
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  }

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x =
        Description_wrapped,
      y = NES,
      fill =
        colour_score
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.9
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#004C8C",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#A63A2A",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(
        -colour_limit,
        colour_limit
      ),
      oob =
        scales::squish,
      name =
        expression(
          -log[10](p) %*% sign(NES)
        )
    ) +
    labs(
      title =
        paste0(
          layer_label,
          " | GSEA | Gene Ontology"
        ),
      x = NULL,
      y =
        "Normalized enrichment score (NES)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(
      base_size = 10
    ) +
    theme(
      text =
        element_text(
          color = "black"
        ),

      plot.title =
        element_text(
          hjust = 0.5,
          face = "bold",
          size = 11
        ),

      axis.text =
        element_text(
          color = "black"
        ),

      axis.title.x =
        element_text(
          color = "black",
          size = 12
        ),

      axis.text.y =
        element_text(
          size = 9,
          color = "black",
          lineheight = 0.7
        ),

      panel.grid.minor =
        element_blank(),

      legend.position =
        "bottom",

      legend.direction =
        "horizontal",

      legend.title =
        element_text(
          size = 9
        ),

      legend.text =
        element_text(
          size = 9
        )
    ) +
    guides(
      fill =
        guide_colorbar(
          barwidth =
            grid::unit(
              6,
              "cm"
            ),

          barheight =
            grid::unit(
              0.3,
              "cm"
            ),

          title.position =
            "top",

          title.hjust =
            0.5
        )
    )
}


matched_factor2_rna_go_gsea_simplified <-
  matched_rna_gsea_simplified_objects[[
    "Factor2__GO_ALL"
  ]]


matched_factor2_proteomics_go_gsea_simplified <-
  matched_proteomics_gsea_simplified_objects[[
    "Factor2__GO_ALL"
  ]]


matched_factor2_rna_gsea_plot <-
  make_factor2_simplified_gsea_plot(
    gsea_object =
      matched_factor2_rna_go_gsea_simplified,

    layer_label =
      "Transcriptomics"
  )


matched_factor2_proteomics_gsea_plot <-
  make_factor2_simplified_gsea_plot(
    gsea_object =
      matched_factor2_proteomics_go_gsea_simplified,

    layer_label =
      "Proteomics"
  )


matched_factor2_simplified_gsea_plot <-
  matched_factor2_rna_gsea_plot |
  matched_factor2_proteomics_gsea_plot


print(
  matched_factor2_simplified_gsea_plot
)
```
